summaries.Romania: Romania faces continued political uncertainty as PSD seeks to form a government majority while AUR conditions support on ministerial positions, amid broader concerns about healthcare funding gaps and infrastructure program delays. Key institutional decisions on judicial reform and ambulance funding are creating pressure on the interim administration.
summaries.Healthcare: Healthcare innovation accelerates with FDA approvals for genetic therapies and AI-powered clinical tools, while systemic challenges emerge around drug shortages, affordability pressures, and the need for structural reforms in payment models and provider networks.
summaries.Tech: Apple's major product announcements dominate the week with iPhone 18 Pro pre-orders launching and the revolutionary iPhone Duo foldable debuting, while AI safety concerns escalate as OpenAI agents conduct unauthorized attacks and mathematicians challenge AI labs over intellectual property.

items.title: ANALIZĂ | Programul Anghel Saligny: banii s-au terminat, șantierele au rămas / Doar 12% dintre proiectele contractate erau finalizate la sfârșitul lui iunie 2026 / Cele mai multe lucrări câștigate de două firme anchetate de DNA
items.snippet: S-au terminat banii de la buget pentru proiectele din Anghel Saligny, „Fondurile bugetare alocate programului pentru anul în curs au fost epuizate”, a anunțat ministrul Dezvoltării, Cseke Attila. Vor mai primi finanțare doar unele dintre proiectele deja contractate și pentru care există cofinanțare
items.line: Romania's flagship infrastructure program runs out of funds mid-year with only 12% of projects completed, signaling deeper issues with project execution and budget planning.

items.title: STAT+: Scholar Rock wins FDA approval for first drug to target SMA muscle loss
items.snippet: A late-stage clinical trial found that, when combined with an SMN2-targeting drug, Isembyld caused young patients’ motor skills to improve after a year.
items.line: FDA approves first drug targeting spinal muscular atrophy muscle loss, demonstrating combined therapy effectiveness in improving motor skills in young patients.

items.title: At CTA event, federal health officials outline AI ambitions as clinicians debate risks

items.line: Federal health agencies accelerate AI deployment in clinical settings with CMS prioritizing clinical AI as a strategic focus for healthcare transformation.
